g.text: $ co --version
$ co gmail draft --help
Usage: python -m connectonion.cli.main gmail draft [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
Create, inspect, and edit Gmail drafts; sending always asks for confirmation.
│ --help Show this message and exit. │
│ list List Gmail drafts, numbered for later draft commands. │
│ create Create an unsent Gmail draft. │
│ attach Stage a local/Drive file, or append a Drive link, without sending. │
│ remove Remove one staged attachment; the draft remains unsent. │
│ replace Atomically replace one staged attachment without sending. │
│ preview Print recipients, body, and the final attachment manifest. │
│ send Preview a draft and send it only after interactive confirmation. │
$ co syno --help
Usage: python -m connectonion.cli.main syno [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
Browse, search, download, upload, and share Synology NAS files. Bare 'co syno' lists shared
folders.
│ --help Show this message and exit. │
│ login Connect your NAS by QuickConnect ID, or directly with --url. │
│ ls List shared folders, or the contents of one folder. │
│ search Search the NAS by file name. │
│ get Download a file from the NAS. │
│ put Upload a local file to the NAS. │
│ share Create a public sharing link for a file or folder. │
